herbal-skin-oil-50ml.description:
Lookman-e-Hayat (also spelled lookmaan e hayat oil, Lookman E Hayat Tel or Luqman-e-Hayat Tel) is a well-known traditional herbal oil with just two ingredients: black sesame (til) oil 97% and guggul resin 3%. It is used across Pakistan and South Asia as an everyday massage and skin oil. It is a traditional cosmetic herbal oil, not a medicine — for external use only, and results vary from person to person.

What is it used for?

  • Old burn marks (purane jalne ke daag): a traditional use. A small amount is massaged daily into old, fully healed burn marks or scars — with regular use it is traditionally believed to soften and gradually lighten how they look. Results vary from person to person. Never use it on a fresh, open or unhealed burn — cool a fresh burn under running water and see a doctor.
  • Massage (malish): warmed slightly and massaged into tired muscles and joints after a long day.
  • Dry, rough skin — elbows, knees, heels and hands.
  • Hair & scalp (champi) — massaged in, left 30–60 minutes, then washed out.

The manufacturer's label describes it as a traditional oil for burns, cuts, sprains, swelling and massage. We are a reseller and present it honestly as a traditional herbal oil, not a registered medicine — for any fresh injury or medical concern, see a doctor.

What is in it?

  • Sesamum Indicum (black sesame / til) seed oil — 97%
  • Commiphora Mukul (guggul) resin — 3%

Made by M.U. Amrelia (India) — the original, genuine product, sold sealed in Pakistan by Glow Halal (Karachi).

Safety

  • For external use only. Keep away from eyes; keep out of reach of children.
  • Patch test before first use. Stop if irritation occurs.
  • Do not apply to fresh burns, cuts, open wounds or broken skin.
  • Pregnant/nursing or have a medical condition? Ask your doctor first.
  • Store below 30°C, away from sunlight. Read the label on your pack.

herbal-skin-oil-50ml.how_to_use:
1. Patch test first. Apply a drop to a small area of your inner forearm and wait 24 hours. If any redness or itching appears, do not use.
  2. Warm the oil slightly. Stand the closed bottle in a bowl of warm water for a few minutes — the manufacturer notes slight warming helps absorption. Never microwave the bottle or heat the oil over a flame, and test the temperature on your wrist first.
  3. Apply a small amount to healthy, unbroken skin.
  4. Massage gently until the oil is absorbed.
  5. Frequency: per the manufacturer's directions, use 2–3 times a day at most.
  6. For scalp and hair (champi): massage a small amount into the scalp, leave for 30–60 minutes, then wash out with your usual shampoo.
  • Never apply to cuts, burns, wounds or irritated skin.
  • Keep away from the eyes, and wash your hands after applying.
herbal-skin-oil-50ml.how_to_use_ur:
• Chand qatre haath mein le kar halka garm karein.
  • Jild par narmi se maalish karein jab tak jazb na ho.
  • Chehre par bohat kam miqdar, raat ko — aankhon se door.
  • Purane nishanon par rozana, sabar ke sath — natijay har jild par mukhtalif.

faqs.q: Kya ye purane jalne ke daag par kaam karta hai? (Does it fade old burn marks?)
faqs.a: This is its best-known traditional use. Massage a small amount daily into old, fully healed burn marks or scars — with regular use it is traditionally believed to soften and gradually lighten their appearance. Results vary from person to person, and it takes consistency over weeks. It must never be used on fresh, open or unhealed burns.

faqs.q: What are the ingredients in Lookman-e-Hayat oil?
faqs.a: Just two: 97% til (sesame) seed oil and 3% guggul (Commiphora mukul) resin — the manufacturer's full declared composition, published on this page. No mineral oil, artificial fragrance or colour is declared. It is a plant-based herbal oil for external use only.

faqs.q: Can I put it on a fresh burn, cut or open wound?
faqs.a: No — never. For a fresh burn, cool the area under clean running water for 10–20 minutes and see a doctor. This oil is only for old, fully healed marks and for massage on healthy, unbroken skin.

faqs.q: How do I use it, and how often?
faqs.a: Patch test first (a drop on the inner forearm, wait 24 hours). Slightly warm the oil, apply a small amount, and massage gently until absorbed — up to 2–3 times a day per the manufacturer's directions. For old marks, daily consistency matters. For hair, massage into the scalp, leave 30–60 minutes, then wash.

faqs.q: Is it a medicine?
faqs.a: No. It is a traditional herbal oil for external use, not a registered medicine, and it is not a substitute for medical care. For any medical problem, please consult a doctor.

faqs.q: Who makes it — is this the original one?
faqs.a: Yes — it is the genuine Lookman E Hayat Tel manufactured by M.U. Amrelia (India). Glow Halal is a Karachi-based reseller; we sell the original, sealed product with Cash on Delivery across Pakistan.

faqs.q: Which size should I choose — 50ml or 100ml?
faqs.a: The 50ml bottle (Rs 1,200) is right for trying it or for a single small area. The 100ml bottle (Rs 2,200) is cheaper per ml — better for daily use on marks or regular massage.

faqs.q: How do I order? Is Cash on Delivery available?

faqs.q: How should I store it?
faqs.a: In a cool, dry place below 30°C, away from direct sunlight, cap closed tightly, out of reach of children. Check the expiry date printed on your pack.

faqs.q: Kya Lookman-e-Hayat tel chehre par laga sakte hain? (Can I use it on the face?)
faqs.a: Yes — it can be used on the face as a light massage or overnight moisturising oil, and many people use it on old, fully-healed marks. Use only a small amount, patch-test on your inner forearm first, and keep it well away from the eyes. If your skin is oily or acne-prone, use it sparingly at night and stop if you notice any breakouts. Never apply it to fresh, broken or unhealed skin.

faqs.q: Kya ye keel-muhaanse (pimples) ke liye theek hai? (Is it good for pimples / acne?)
faqs.a: It is a traditional massage and skin oil, not an acne treatment, and we make no claim that it clears pimples. Sesame oil is fairly rich, so on acne-prone skin a heavy layer can sometimes make breakouts worse. If you want to try it, use a tiny amount at night, patch-test first, and stop if your skin reacts. For persistent acne, a doctor or dermatologist is the right person to see.
